title: Anagram groups
statement:
Two words are anagrams when one is a rearrangement of the letters of the other ("listen" and "silent"). A word with no anagram forms a group of its own.
Input: the first line holds n (1 <= n <= 1000). Each of the next n lines holds one word of 1 to 20 lowercase letters a-z. All words are distinct.
Output: print every group of anagrams on its own line, its words sorted alphabetically and separated by single spaces. Print the groups from the largest to the smallest; groups of the same size are ordered by their first (alphabetically smallest) word.

Example
Input:
6
listen
google
enlist
cat
silent
act
Output:
enlist listen silent
act cat
google
